tasks.task: OpenAI research pages are getting rate-limited in our LLMS.txt Explorer, so before tomorrow’s daily crawl window, disable the OpenAI website entry (id: llms_web_01J2E3G8B0W7N7WZ8Z4N8C9B5R) to prevent repeated 429 failures, and verify the most recent check shows the 429 blocked error that justifies disabling it.

success_criteria: The latest failed check for website llms_web_01J2E3G8B0W7N7WZ8Z4N8C9B5R (returned by list_website_checks) is retrievable via get_website_check and shows http_status_code=429 and error_code="blocked" (or an equivalent rate-limit message).
update_website sets website llms_web_01J2E3G8B0W7N7WZ8Z4N8C9B5R to status="disabled" without error.
A final get_website for llms_web_01J2E3G8B0W7N7WZ8Z4N8C9B5R returns status="disabled".

tasks.task: We’re doing a compliance sweep today: disable the OpenAI site entry (id: llms_web_01J2E3G8B0W7N7WZ8Z4N8C9B5R) immediately because our policy says any origin that returns a 429 ‘blocked’ during llms discovery cannot remain active. success_criteria: The fetched latest failed check for llms_web_01J2E3G8B0W7N7WZ8Z4N8C9B5R shows http_status_code = 429 and error_code = 'blocked'.
update_website returns the OpenAI website with status = 'disabled'.

tasks.task: We’re deprecating Stripe docs from our LLMS index due to a policy change that takes effect by EOD today. The check_website result corresponds to canonical_origin https://docs.stripe.com and website.id == llms_web_01J2E1R6MB5Q8Q1D3QZP9M0WJH.
The list_llms_artifacts call returns at least one active llms.txt artifact for this website, and the task output can report its URL (e.g., data[0].url).
